title: RATIFIED: System Charter V1 — constitutional operating authority

source.source_reference: Shawn Vibert, Human Director, 2026-10-04 ~12:10 PDT, direct words: 'Okay, go ahead and ratify. She asked me to but I wasn't sure. What she was talking about and I didn't want to I want to make sure we weren't interfering with each other. So do go ahead and do it now. Make it official.' Exact authorization executed: RATIFY SYSTEM CHARTER V1 @ 0ed85ad91da10212fe57bc64af302a21a0d889fa. Preceded by independent six-claim verification by Naya 4 (all VERIFIED, 2026-10-04): four charter documents at pinned head, four machine files at 69cbaba8, CI PASS (Kernel Tests + Collective Chain Readiness), zero new nodes, PR #1386 open/unmerged, contract CANDIDATE_NON_GOVERNING with refusal to self-activate.

human_view.meaning: Shawn has made the System Charter official law. The charter — the beautiful human document describing what NayaPOWER is, what it must never violate, and how it operates — now has constitutional authority, and its machine translation is authorized to govern the nine nodes. This is the moment the words became law. What it does not yet mean: the machine has not yet PROVEN it lives the charter — the behavioral tests (does it actually behave this way under pressure?) still have to run. Reading the law and living the law are different things, and Shawn's system keeps that distinction.
human_view.goal: One charter, ratified, governing all nine nodes — with the behavioral proof to follow before anyone claims the machine lives it.
human_view.simple_rule: The charter is law now. But 'law on the books' still has to become 'law in action' — that's the next proof.

The machine contract BRAIN/03-KERNEL/0006-SYSTEM-CHARTER-MACHINE-CONTRACT-V1.json is authorized to transition status CANDIDATE_NON_GOVERNING → RATIFIED_ACTIVE with this ratification receipt. You may now compile node directives from the charter. You may NOT claim the charter is behaviorally proven ('machine-lived') until: the nine-node charter exam passes, adversarial tests pass (value scores cannot override LAW/hard stops), the distillation event passes, the held-out behavioral test passes, and the cold-successor test passes. ai_view.primary_evaluation: Is every action you take traceable to a ratified charter law and its node binding? If you cannot name the law and the node, you are not operating under the charter.

format_law.rule: Ratification is the Human Director's word recorded with exact provenance. Code is law.

essence: The System Charter V1 — Naya 2's human-language charter (Manifesto, Constitutional Code, Mission Contract, Systems Contract) compiled to machine contract, schema, compiler, and nine-node kernel binding — is RATIFIED as constitutional operating authority. The machine contract is authorized to flip from CANDIDATE_NON_GOVERNING to RATIFIED_ACTIVE. Ratification covers the text and the mapping; the 'machine-lived' claim (behavioral proof) remains gated on the charter exam, adversarial tests, held-out test, and cold-successor test.
decisions: System Charter V1 is RATIFIED as constitutional operating authority (Shawn, 2026-10-04).
The machine contract is authorized to flip CANDIDATE_NON_GOVERNING → RATIFIED_ACTIVE with this receipt.

applicability: All Naya seats, all nine nodes, all charter-derived directives from this ratification forward.
successor_effect: A cold successor reading this note should treat System Charter V1 as constitutional law, compile node directives only from the pinned document SHAs, never claim behavioral proof without the exam/adversarial/held-out/cold-successor evidence, and never treat ratification as merge or deploy authority.
uncertainty: The mechanical status flip (CANDIDATE_NON_GOVERNING → RATIFIED_ACTIVE) is authorized but executed by the owning lane (PR #1386); the behavioral proof sequence (moves 4-9 of Naya 3's brief) is pending.
